status: Exploratory independent reading; reviewer-made, not an expert certification
written_before_opening: comparison.json beyond the IDs in its changes list
code values in research/chart_reference/manual_numeric_reference.json (only cell IDs and the cells that have alternatives were taken)
source: research/corpus/primary/koskenniemi_parpola1979.pdf, PDF pages 20-21 (embedded 1-bit image 4880 x 7010 px, about 8.34 px per point)
cell_geometry: clip rectangles from the package render-manifest.json (geometry only)
method: Rendered each cell from the PDF at 10x (full cell) and 20x (label area), read class number and code by eye (eye_pass_code).

Extracted the native 1-bit page image, segmented the label digits by connected components, and compared every digit with mean templates built from the digits of this sample that were clear by eye (leave-self-out normalised correlation after resizing to 26x38 and blurring). The pixel check agreed with the eye pass on 345 of 351 digits. Five disagreements, each a 5 by eye and a 6 by template, changed the code (changed_after_pixel_check); the sixth was a thin 1 scored against a 4 template and changed nothing.
code is the reading after the pixel check. confidence is the reviewer judgement; medium and low-medium readings list the alternative codes considered.

post_hoc_notes.digit_count_check: review/shape_features.py segments 354 digits in the 63 cells (class numbers and codes). The eye pass differed from the pixel check at 5 digits, each a 5 by eye and a 6 by template, in p20_c4_r13, p21_c0_r1, p21_c0_r18, p21_c3_r4 and p21_c5_r34. The method text above quotes 345 of 351 digits from an earlier scratch run that scored one thin 1 as a 4 and omitted the 3-digit code of p21_c8_r5.
post_hoc_notes.top_stroke_ranges: Clear 5s: top stroke 73-96% of digit width (28 digits). Clear 6s: 41-60% (28 digits).
post_hoc_notes.p21_c6_r1: A later whole-chart nearest-neighbour check (review/knn_check.py) puts the last code digit among the 8s (7 of 7 neighbours; mean similarity of the ten most similar 8s 0.879, 6s 0.750), which supports 208 more than the low-medium confidence recorded above.
